description: Support ticket reply create: the confirm gate, invalid-ticket_id and description-required rejections (confirm set so both reach them), and the reply POST once confirmed. The missing-ticket_id message diverges (see report). A body that will not parse must fail rather than turn into a made-up reply. The two languages frame the parse failure differently, so the shared assertion is the parser's position marker.
